title: I Wasn’t a Football Fan… Then I Went to the World Cup
description:
#AD I wasn’t a football fan… until YouTube invited me to experience the FIFA World Cup from the inside.

Over 11 unforgettable days, I traveled through 4 cities, attended 6 matches, stood pitch-side, explored empty stadiums and locker rooms, watched games from behind the goal, and experienced the energy of football fans up close😍

I came here thinking I would simply create content and go home. But somewhere between the chants, celebrations, emotional moments, and thousands of people supporting their countries together, everything changed.

Thank you @YouTube for this unforgettable experience💗
#FIFAWorldCup
